Aurelith Terminal, ticket desk.
All lines run on the hour.

Welcome to the capital!
Mind your step on the platform.

Aurelith Terminal, ticket desk.

Welcome to the capital!
Mind your step on the platform.

Riders keep between the flags. Not in
the grotto. Not at dusk.

No ride yet? Stay on the sand.
Cast a line from the shore.

Riders keep between the flags. Not in
the grotto. Not at dusk.

No ride yet? Stay on the sand.
Cast a line from the shore.

The road home passes Lantern Rest.
Sit on the bench for a while?

You sit. The river runs below,
slow and new.

For a moment, it feels like
you've been here before.
